bulldog.definitionKo: 머리가 크고 넓적하며 양쪽 볼이 처져 있는 개.
bulldog.englishDescription: A dog which has a large square head and sagged cheeks.

bulldozer.definitionKo: 흙을 밀어 내어 땅을 다지거나 평평하게 하는 데 쓰는 특수 자동차.
bulldozer.englishDescription: A special vehicle used for hardening or flattening the ground by pushing out dirt.

bulldozer.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 앞뒤를 생각하지 않고 무조건 일을 밀고 나가는 사람.
bulldozer.englishDescription: (figurative) A person who pushes ahead with something at all costs without deliberation.

bungalow.definitionKo: 처마가 깊숙하고 정면에 베란다가 있는 인도식의 작은 단층집.
bungalow.englishDescription: A small, Indian-style one-storied house with lengthy eaves and a veranda in the front.

deletion.definitionKo: 대본이나 촬영한 필름에서 필요 없는 부분을 삭제하는 일.
deletion.englishDescription: An act of deleting unnecessary parts from a script or film.

desperately.definitionKo: 모든 것을 바쳐 한 가지 일만 적극적으로 하는 모양.
desperately.englishExpression: as if dying or living; desperately; tooth and nail
desperately.englishDescription: To focus on doing only one thing by giving one's life and all.

encamp.englishExpression: set up an outpost; make a camp; encamp
encamp.englishDescription: For many people to occupy the same space.

ion.definitionKo: 양의 전기나 음의 전기를 띤 원자 또는 원자의 집단.
ion.englishDescription: An atom or a group of atoms with either positive or negative electrical charges.

karaoke.englishDescription: A machine that plays accompaniment to a popular song.

karaoke.definitionKo: 노래 없이 반주만 녹음된 기계가 있는 술집.
karaoke.englishDescription: A bar equipped with machine that plays accompaniment to a popular song.

meter.englishDescription: A bound noun used as a unit of length.

waiter.definitionKo: 서양식 음식점이나 호텔 등에서 음식을 나르거나 손님의 시중을 드는 남자 종업원.
waiter.englishDescription: A male employee serving food or attending a customer in a western restaurant or hotel etc.
